title: Polynomial bound for the learning family
statement: Let $n,d,Q\in\mathbb{N}$ with $1\leq n$, and let $0<\varepsilon\leq 1/2$ satisfy $1/(Q+1)\leq\varepsilon$. For the quantities defined by $t=\sqrt{d\,\lceil\log_2(n+1)\rceil}+1$, $e=\lceil t/(\varepsilon/8)\rceil$, $\theta=(\varepsilon/8)^2/t^2\,(1/9)^e$, $c=\lceil 2t/\theta\rceil$, $B=(e+1)(c+1)^e$, $r=2e_0(c_0+1)$ with $e_0=8(d+2)(Q+1)+1$ and $c_0=128(Q+1)^2(d+2)^3+4e_0+5$, and $C=2^r$, one has $B\leq C(n+1)^r$.
